Description: Nacelle and pylon components shall withstand operational thermal environments from -55°C to +85°C ambient and engine heat zones up to 200°C.
Acceptance_Criteria: Material properties maintained within limits across temperature range

Description: The nacelle acoustic treatment shall provide noise attenuation to meet ICAO Chapter 14 and CS-36 noise certification requirements.
Acceptance_Criteria: Cumulative noise margin ≥10 EPNdB below limits

Description: The nacelle inlet shall be protected against ice accretion under FAR/CS-25 Appendix C icing conditions.
Acceptance_Criteria: No ice accumulation affecting engine performance

Description: The nacelle structure shall provide lightning strike protection for Zone 1A/1B/2A attachments per DO-160G Section 23.
Acceptance_Criteria: No structural damage or fuel ignition hazard

Description: The nacelle inlet and acoustic panels shall resist damage from rain erosion and hail impact per CS-25 requirements.
Acceptance_Criteria: No degradation of acoustic or structural performance after exposure
